known_issues: v10.10.2 installed and 268 tests passed on target Windows/Docker. All model candidates degraded. v10.10.3 model responsiveness and target timings remain unverified; 5070.08 MB MemAvailable was observed before the v1.5 probe, not total RAM/VRAM.
The memory estimate is conservative and cannot guarantee that an arbitrary model fits arbitrary hardware.
The micro-selection model contract does not establish unrestricted general business reasoning or universal Operator coverage.
Per-company local document retrieval is not a production per-document ACL ingestion pipeline; RAG remains disabled by default.
Prediction quality requires dedicated real datasets and rolling backtests; this release changes no forecast formula.
Synchronous ERP tool network timeouts remain separate from the Kernel inference deadline.
Global context admission can reject oversized legacy model prompts; use supported deterministic reads or explicitly tune max_context for measured capacity. No silent prompt truncation.

A 60-second first-request allowance may still be insufficient on the target. Shared 30-second endpoint cooldown prevents immediate model load cascades; it does not guarantee daemon cancellation or model capacity.
